description: The strongest ultraviolet line in the universe: a hydrogen electron falling from the first excited state to the ground state. It lights up nebulae and the distant Lyman-alpha forest of quasars.
configuration: Single discrete quantum jump: n = 2 → n = 1 at 121.6 nm — one photon of 10.2 eV per jump. His term "quanta jumps" catalogs exactly these measured transitions.
